Status.note:
Open the EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx and go to the Operating sheet.

Status:
- Plant 4040 rows 1CT1, 1CT2 and ST1 all read '(OP) Operating'.
- The Planned Retirement Year column is blank for every row, so no retirement is announced.
- The only change listed is a planned uprate in 2028, which matches the docket 6630-CE-318 application. No mothballing or sale was found.

verifications.note: Read on PDF page 17, section 1.1.7 Estimated Capacity Factors.

Backup Power.note:
Open the Wisconsin Electric application at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=565256 and go to PDF page 17, section 1.1.7, titled Estimated Capacity Factors. It says 'the annual dispatch profile of the existing CTs is not expected to materially change' and discusses their annual capacity factor. Page 34 says the turbines 'currently operate solely on natural gas'.

What this means:
- The turbines run as normal grid supply, not as an emergency fleet.
- The document never uses the words backup power, so this supports 'no' by implication only.

units.notes: The EIA table for September 2026 lists the unit as operating with no planned retirement. The 2025 application for docket 6630-CE-318 plans a turbine upgrade in 2028 and no retirement. Status Detail already records the 2028 upgrade, so it is not restated.
